notes.notes:

I'm happy to report the coin room's spin the wheel mini game in the easy money casino ( freewill ) as been fixed. If anyone notice the wheel wouldn't appear on the first play, fret no more. A new animation image for the war ready skill as been added. And the coolest note for this update is a new machine gun added in the game called "elephant mod 1". That's all for now cadets.

notes.title: Spin the wheel mini game fix, new animation, and a new gun ! 8/27/23
notes.notes: I'm happy to report the coin room's spin the wheel mini game in the easy money casino ( freewill ) as been fixed. If anyone notice the wheel wouldn't appear on the first play, fret no more. A new animation image for the war ready skill as been added. And the coolest note for this update is a new machine gun added  in the game called  "elephant mod 1".  That's all for now cadets.

notes.title: Dice roll patch for 8/4
notes.notes: This patch includes price reduction on store items such as smoke bombs, C-4, and more. Animal enemies now have a 10 gold increases.

notes.title: Dice roll patch!
notes.notes: New stats for enemies, items and more. Find out what has change!

notes.title: Improvements
notes.notes: I'm updating the demo with a new weapon to unlock the war axe, a more full game accurate user interface, and a better overall experience. The update will be up 5/11  before noon (EST).
